questions.question: Inside the run_conversation function's while loop, what determines whether the loop breaks and returns a final answer versus continuing?
options: Whether the response's stop_reason is tool_use (continue) or something else (break and return)
Whether the message list has grown past a fixed length
Whether the user sends a new message
A fixed number of iterations set before the loop starts

questions.question: When Claude's response has stop_reason tool_use, what does run_conversation do before looping again?
options: Runs the requested tool and appends the resulting tool_result block(s) to the message list
Immediately returns the tool_use block to the end user as the final answer
Discards the tool_use block and re-sends the original prompt unchanged
Switches to a different model for the next call

questions.question: Why does run_conversation keep calling Claude in a while loop instead of returning after the first response?
options: Because Claude may need several tool calls before it stops asking for tools and produces a final answer
Because the API requires at least three calls per conversation
Because the first response is always incomplete
Because tool_result blocks must be sent one at a time with a delay
